item.summary: chore(skills): unify issue/PR repair sweeps into openclaw-repair-sweep (#120465) Merge openclaw-small-bugfix-sweep, openclaw-landable-bug-sweep, and openclaw-autonomous-issue-sweep into one openclaw-repair-sweep skill with scope/batch_size/workers inputs and sensible defaults. Fold in the transferable doctrine from the retired personal super-orchestrator runbook: broken-main repair as standing sweep work, mandatory follow-up refactor pass, defect-class batching with one canonical helper, ancestry-based merge verification, and push-then-escalate for maintainer decisions. Update the auto-qa companion reference.
